verdict.rationale: Box documents webhooks that send notifications to a URL of your choice when content events occur (V1 and V2, including a V2 file-download example), plus an event feed for real-time user and enterprise event streams. That covers the push-notification core of the story. The pack says nothing about signature verification or retry and delivery semantics, which the story explicitly asks for. missing for 10: webhook signature/verification documentation, retry and delivery-guarantee semantics, independent or hands-on corroboration.
